text: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: After learning this program, students can know more about how to identify and analyze worldwide marketing opportunities, and examine product, pricing, distribution and promotion strategies. International Marketing examines the impact of economic, cultural, political, legal and other environmental influences on international marketing. Within this context, the focus is on how to identify and analyze worldwide marketing opportunities, and examine product, pricing, distribution and promotion strategies. ​ 2. Specialization courses Editor Notes: Students are required to accomplish all compulsory specialization courses of their own majors. Besides, they need to select 7 more specialization courses from other majors. International Marketing Management (compulsory) Consumer Behavior (compulsory) Brand Management (compulsory) Marketing Research Methods (compulsory) International Business Entrepreneurship International Business Negotiation Strategic Management Internation Investment Analysis International Finance M&A and Investment Banking Financial Markets and Institutions Chinese Business Environment Chinese Culture & Business Etiquette China Business Law Doing Business in China 3. Internship and Career Editor Notes: Students of this program will have chances of do internships in multinational companies and organizations in China. Opportunities in multinational companies and organizations in China. 4. Introduction of Beijing Foreign Studies University-International Business School(BFSUIBS) Editor Notes: IBS is one of the youngest and most vigorous schools of Beijing Foreign Studies University (BFSU). International Business School (IBS) is one of the youngest and most dynamic schools at Beijing Foreign Studies University (BFSU) and also the largest in terms of student number. Founded in 2001, IBS currently has more than 1500 students including undergraduates, postgraduates, international students, and overseas foundation programs students. IBS aims to provide future business elites from all over the world with the core of Chinese and world civilizations, pass on common values of all humanity, probe business knowledge both known and unknown, and help its students discover their own unique characters and values of life.
